title: Inline rescue strip and animated retry GIFs for quickstart error flows
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact, single-line ‘rescue strip’ and a set of animated GIFs that live in quickstart and docs pages to help users recover from transient errors (rate limits, timeouts, retries). Deliver static PNG assets for docs, a 3-variant animated GIF pack for embedded product screenshots, and copy variants tuned for beginner vs platform-engineer audiences.
tasks: Audit existing quickstart pages and ticket screenshots for places to embed rescue strip
Design 3 visual variants: Calm-guidance, Action-first, and Technical-detail
Create 3 animated GIFs for retry flow: retry-success, retry-failed-then-backoff, backoff-with-countdown
Export masked product screenshots (no API keys) in 2 sizes for docs and onboarding modal
Write microcopy for each variant including keyboard-first guidance and copy for accessibility readers
Handoff tokens and specs to ENG for integration (placement, z-index, responsive behavior)
acceptance_criteria: Rescue strip component exported as SVG + PNG at 1x/2x and annotated in Figma
Animated GIFs under 800KB each, looped, include a 2s start-to-finish cycle
Microcopy reviewed by PM and Docs with two tone variants (Beginner / Engineer)
Contrast ratio meets AA (4.5:1) for body text; focus states documented
Integration notes added to ENG ticket (ENG-40102) with example CSS and fallback image
All screenshot exports sanitized (no tokens) and uploaded to Drive with naming convention
